glosses: To put in a random order.

examples.text: Don't forget to shuffle the cards.

glosses: To change; modify the order of something.

examples.text: But, rather than make a change up front, Hughes shuffled his defence for this match, replacing Carlos Salcido with Baird, in a move which few would have predicted would prove decisive.

glosses: To move in a slovenly, dragging manner; to drag or scrape the feet in walking or dancing.

examples.text: He shuffled out of the room.

examples.text: I myself, […] hiding mine honour in my necessity, am fain to shuffle.

examples.text: Your life, good master, / Must shuffle for itself.
